summary: QMMM Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on April 22, 2026, reporting the resignation of independent director Chun Kit Yu effective April 20, 2026. Yu resigned as independent director, audit committee chair, and member of compensation and nominating committees, citing personal reasons with no dispute with the company. The board's nominating committee has begun searching for a replacement; an update will follow upon appointment. This is a non-routine board departure warranting classification as a management change.
